input.command: maude design index .design/ui/GitPanel.tsx --verbose 2>&1 || maude design index ui/GitPanel.tsx --artboards 2>&1
input.description: Get detailed artboard list for GitPanel

input.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git diff --stat -- .design/ui/GitPanel.meta.json; git show HEAD:.design/ui/GitPanel.meta.json 2>/dev/null | head -5
input.description: Check if artboards field predates my edit

input.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('.design/ui/GitPanel.meta.json'))
print(json.dumps(d.get('present'), indent=2))
print(json.dumps(d.get('artboardMeta'), indent=2))
ids = {a['id'] for a in d['artboards']}
print('ids', ids)
print('order valid?', set(d['present']['order']) <= ids)
print('skip valid?', set(d['present']['skip']) <= ids)
"
input.description: Sanity-check present/artboardMeta ids against canvas artboard ids
Open GitPanel canvas in Present mode
